Class EventPhysicalImpactExecutor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.EventPhysicalImpactExecutor
public final class EventPhysicalImpactExecutor extends Object

EventPhysicalImpactExecutor

Centralized, fully headless physical execution engine for planetary events, astronomical forcings, cataclysms, and ecological shocks.

Epistemic Modeling Principle — Exogenous Boundary Forcings vs. Emergence:
In macroeconomic and Earth System Models (ESMs, CMIP6, IPCC), external shocks such as explosive volcanic eruptions (e.g., 1815 Tambora, 1257 Samalas) or extraterrestrial impacts are not artificial ad-hoc overrides of internal dynamics; they constitute authentic exogenous boundary conditions. Ether strictly routes these external events through biophysical conservation channels:

  • Atmospheric aerosol optical depth \(\tau\) attenuating top-of-atmosphere solar irradiance: \(S = S_0 \cdot e^{-\tau}\) (Beer-Lambert law).
  • Thermodynamic surface cooling and precipitation reduction impacting net primary productivity (NPP).
  • Physical infrastructure and agricultural capital degradation through exponential survival curves: \(K(t^+) = K(t^-) \cdot e^{-\alpha \cdot \text{magnitude}}\).
Governs both scheduled scenario shocks and live exploratory sandbox interventions, ensuring complete bitwise and mathematical parity between GUI and headless executions (AGENTS.md §1, §7, §10).

    • isBioclimaticallyPlausible

      public static boolean isBioclimaticallyPlausible(String upperType, H3Cell cell)
      Checks if a cell is bioclimatically and geographically plausible for a physical event type. Prevents biological, geographical, and physical anomalies (e.g. desert locusts in arctic tundra, fishery collapses in landlocked deserts, tsunamis on high mountains, or wildfires in open ocean).
      Parameters:
      upperType - uppercase event type string
      cell - simulation cell
      Returns:
      true if shock can physically manifest on this cell
